title: Potential misuse for deepfakes and 3D human assets
description: SDI could marginally improve the ability of bad actors to generate deepfakes or create 3D assets corresponding to real humans for use in virtual environments or games. It also inherits any biases present in the 2D model.
canonical_description: potential misuse of improved 3D generation for deepfakes and inheriting 2D model biases
